title: The FBI and USDA were reportedly hacked

claims.claim: ABD Tarım Bakanlığı (USDA) ve FBI'ın hacklendiği bildirildi.

evidence.quote: Friday, it was reported that both the US Department of Agriculture (USDA) and the FBI were hacked.
FBI and USDA were reportedly targeted in back-to-back cyberattacks

claims.claim: CNN, FBI'ın son birkaç ay içinde ikinci kez saldırıya uğradığını bildirdi.

evidence.quote: In reporting on the FBI hack, CNN noted that this is the second such attack on the agency in the last few months

claims.claim: FBI saldırısının, kolluk kuvvetlerinin bilgi paylaşımı için kullandığı Ulusal Suç Bilgi Merkezi'ni (NCIC) hedef aldığı belirtildi.

evidence.quote: this time targeting the National Crime Information Center (NCIC), which federal, state, and local law enforcement use to share information, including warrants and missing persons.

The cybersecurity incident specifically targeted the FBI's National Crime Information Center, which acts as a database that hosts criminal info, like warrants and background checks, and is used by law enforcement agencies across the country.
The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of the National Crime Information Center (NCIC), according to reports in CNN and the Associated Press.

claims.claim: Başkan Donald Trump, Fox News ile yaptığı bir röportajda FBI'ın hacklendiğini doğruladı.

evidence.quote: President Donald Trump later confirmed the hack in an interview with Fox News.

claims.claim: NBC, USDA hack olayını Cuma günü ilk kez rapor etti.

evidence.quote: NBC first reported the USDA hack on Friday.

claims.claim: FAA ve NSA'da yaşanan büyük kesintilerin siber saldırı sonucu olmadığı hükümet tarafından açıklandı.

evidence.quote: The breaches come following a week of major outages across several sectors, including at the FAA and NSA, which the government has sought to reassure the public were not the result of a cyberattack.

claims.claim: Eylül ayı sonlarında bildirilen FBI ihlalinde tüm FBI çalışanlarının ve başvuranların kişisel kayıtlarının ele geçirildiği iddia edildi.

evidence.quote: The FBI suffered a breach, reported in late September, that allegedly compromised personal records of “all FBI employees and applicants.”
The FBI suffered a breach, reported in September, that allegedly compromised personal records of “all FBI employees and applicants.”
Earlier this year, the FBI was reportedly the target of another cyberattack that divulged sensitive data of its employees and job applicants.

claims.claim: Ekim ayında bildirilen DHS hack olayında 40.000 çalışan kaydının ele geçirildiği açıklandı.

evidence.quote: This was followed by a hack of DHS, reported in October, comprising 40,000 employee records.
